questions.question: What is the minimum number of availability zones in a zone-enabled Azure region?

options.why: One zone gives no zone redundancy.

questions.explanation: Zone-enabled regions have at least three availability zones.

questions.question: Which TWO statements about availability zones are true?

options.text: Each zone has independent power, cooling and networking
Zones protect against an entire region going offline
options.why: Zones are inside one region; use another region for that.

options.text: A zone is made up of one or more datacenters
Every Azure region supports availability zones

questions.explanation: Zones are separate datacenter groups inside a region with independent infrastructure.

questions.question: Zone-redundant storage (ZRS) is an example of which type of service?

options.why: Zonal resources are pinned to one zone you choose.
Correct. Azure replicates it across zones.
Non-regional services are not tied to a region.
Sovereign refers to isolated Azure clouds.

questions.explanation: Zone-redundant services are automatically replicated across zones.
